tagline: No BS, just computers built for what you actually need.
intro: We are NoBS Computers — a custom PC builder focused on honest recommendations, clean assembly, and machines that match how you actually use a computer.

promises.title: Transparent parts
promises.description: You see what goes into your build and why. No mystery components, no vague specs — just a clear parts list matched to your budget and use case.

promises.title: No unnecessary upsells
promises.description: We recommend what you need, not what pads a invoice. If a part doesn't help your build, we won't push it.

promises.title: Tested before handoff
promises.description: Every system is assembled carefully, stress-tested, and checked before you receive it. You shouldn't have to troubleshoot a brand-new PC.

howItWorks.title: Tell us what you need
howItWorks.description: Fill out a short questionnaire — use case, budget, parts you already own, and any preferences. No account required to start.

howItWorks.title: We review & chat
howItWorks.description: We look over your request, discuss options in live chat, and answer questions before anything is approved.

howItWorks.title: Build, test & deliver
howItWorks.description: Once approved, we source parts, build your PC, run tests, and keep you updated until it's ready.

services.title: Gaming PCs
services.description: High-FPS rigs tuned for the games you play — from 1080p value builds to high-refresh 1440p and beyond.

services.title: Work & productivity
services.description: Quiet, reliable systems for office work, school, programming, and everyday multitasking.

services.title: Content creation
services.description: Editing, streaming, and creative workloads with the right CPU, GPU, RAM, and storage balance.

services.title: Upgrades & reuse
services.description: Already have a case, SSD, or GPU? Tell us what you own and we'll build around it when it makes sense.

whatYouProvide: What you'll use the PC for (gaming, work, editing, etc.)
Parts you already own — CPU, RAM, SSD, GPU, case, etc.
Preferences — quiet fans, RGB, compact size, specific games or apps

testingSteps.title: Assembly check
testingSteps.description: Clean cable management, secure mounting, and proper thermal paste application.

testingSteps.title: POST & BIOS
testingSteps.description: Power-on self-test, memory detection, and firmware settings verified.

testingSteps.title: Stress testing
testingSteps.description: CPU and GPU run under load to catch instability before the PC leaves the bench.

testingSteps.title: Final inspection
testingSteps.description: Ports, Wi-Fi, audio, and storage checked so the system is ready to use out of the box.

faq.question: Do I need an account to request a build?
faq.answer: No. Start with the Build My PC questionnaire and tell us what you need first. We'll ask you to create a password afterward so you can track your build and chat with us.

faq.question: How long does a custom build take?
faq.answer: Timeline depends on parts availability and current queue. We'll give you a realistic estimate after reviewing your request — usually discussed in chat once we've looked at your specs.

faq.question: Can I use parts I already own?
faq.answer: Often, yes. List what you have in the questionnaire — monitor, storage, GPU, case, etc. We'll tell you honestly if reusing something makes sense or if newer parts are a better fit.

faq.question: Do you mark up parts?
faq.answer: We're upfront about pricing. You'll get a clear quote with transparent parts — no hidden fees or surprise upsells for things you don't need.

faq.question: What if something goes wrong after delivery?
faq.answer: Reach out through your build dashboard chat. If there's a delivery issue, you can report it from your account and we'll follow up.

faq.question: Do you ship or is pickup available?
faq.answer: Details depend on your location — we'll confirm delivery or pickup options when we review your request.
